findings.name: acme-shop-prod
findings.description: A rough monthly cost per team, from a small price table, stays within the team's budget (stack config teamBudgets).
findings.message:
A rough monthly cost per team, from a small price table, stays within the team's budget (stack config teamBudgets).
Team payments would cost about $725/month in prod, over its $600 budget; the top items are payments-db (db.r6g.2xlarge, ~$700), payments-ledger-replica (db.t4g.small, ~$25). Rough list prices.

findings.name: acme-shop-prod
findings.description: The program exports every stack output listed in the project config requiredOutputs.
findings.message:
The program exports every stack output listed in the project config requiredOutputs.
The stack doesn't export searchApiUrl, which other stacks and tools depend on (requiredOutputs in Pulumi.yaml).

findings.name: ops-alerts
findings.description: The entry point (index.ts) only wires team modules together; it declares no resources.
findings.message:
The entry point (index.ts) only wires team modules together; it declares no resources.
The entry point only wires modules together; declare this in the owning team's module under src/<team>/ and export it from there.

findings.name: ops-pager
findings.description: Resources are declared only under src/<team>/ or platform/ (index.ts wires modules).
findings.message:
Resources are declared only under src/<team>/ or platform/ (index.ts wires modules).
lib/ops.ts is outside src/<team>/ and platform/, so no team owns this; move it into the owning team's directory.

findings.message:

findings.name: payments-exports
findings.description: In prod, resources that hold data are protected (protect or retainOnDelete).
findings.message:
In prod, resources that hold data are protected (protect or retainOnDelete).
This holds data and isn't protected in prod; set protect (or retainOnDelete) in its resource options for prod.

findings.name: payments-exports
findings.description: S3 buckets are created with the @acme/platform storage component, not the raw AWS resource.
findings.message:
S3 buckets are created with the @acme/platform storage component, not the raw AWS resource.
Use platform.storage.Bucket instead of a raw S3 bucket; it adds encryption, versioning, a public access block and tags.

findings.name: payments-ledger-replica
findings.description: In prod, resources that hold data are protected (protect or retainOnDelete).
findings.message:

findings.name: payments-ledger-replica
findings.description: In prod, RDS instances keep backups for at least 7 days and have deletion protection on.
findings.message:
In prod, RDS instances keep backups for at least 7 days and have deletion protection on.
In prod this database needs backups kept at least 7 days (it has none set) and deletion protection; set them for prod, or use platform.db.Postgres, which does.

findings.name: payments-ledger-replica
findings.description: Databases are created with the @acme/platform Postgres component, not raw RDS resources.
findings.message:
Databases are created with the @acme/platform Postgres component, not raw RDS resources.
Use platform.db.Postgres instead of a raw RDS database; it is private, encrypted and backed up. Read replicas aren't offered yet: ask the platform team.

findings.name: payments-db-url
findings.description: Resources are not created inside apply callbacks.
findings.message:
Resources are not created inside apply callbacks.
This is created inside an apply callback, so previews can't show it reliably; create it at the top level and pass the Output as its input.

findings.name: payments-api-logs
findings.description: Log groups set a retention of at least 7 days in dev and 90 in prod.
findings.message:
Log groups set a retention of at least 7 days in dev and 90 in prod.
Logs are kept 30 days; stack prod needs a retention of at least 90 days.

findings.name: payments-api-logs
findings.description: Resources don't ignore all changes (`ignoreChanges: ["*"]`).
findings.message:
Resources don't ignore all changes (`ignoreChanges: ["*"]`).
ignoreChanges on everything hides all drift and all future changes; list only the properties something else manages, or remove it.

findings.name: payments-webhook
findings.description: Every service (platform.network.Service or Lambda function) has an alarm and a log group with retention.
findings.message:
Every service (platform.network.Service or Lambda function) has an alarm and a log group with retention.
This service isn't done: it needs an alarm on it and a log group with retention. Every service ships with an alarm and logs that expire.

findings.name: acme-shop-prod
findings.description: The program doesn't use Date.now(), Math.random() or crypto.randomUUID(): every run must declare the same resources.
findings.message:
The program doesn't use Date.now(), Math.random() or crypto.randomUUID(): every run must declare the same resources.
Date.now() gives a different value on every run, so names or inputs built from it change on every update; use a fixed name or a random.RandomId resource.
